title: Revenue trend
summary: Revenue over closed months or quarters - for the selected client, or across the book.

guidance.intake: This template builds a revenue trend over time. Scope follows the page: client on a page that supplies clientId, book otherwise. Grain defaults to quarterly (the last 8 closed quarters) for a client and monthly (the last 24 closed months) for the book. A split adds one series per line of business, or fee vs. NII. A request that is not a revenue trend (a single YTD figure, a ranking of clients) is declined with a suggestion of the Custom widget template.
guidance.build: Revenue comes from revenue_monthly.totalUsd, booked by closed month: exclude the month containing asOfDate. Bucket by the brief's grain, oldest first, and return one row per period (per period and split value when split).
guidance.present: Many periods are a line; 8 or fewer quarters can be a bar. Polarity is higher-is-better. With a split, stack the bars or use one line per series.

suggestions: Monthly revenue by line of business
